TMIS Logical Data Model: schema v3, transcribed from the supplied reference image.
46 entities; the reference draws 54 relationships. Tenant agency_id and most user_id / *_by connectors are omitted in the image for readability; all foreign keys remain explorable here.
PK marks a primary key; FK marks a foreign key; UK marks a unique field. Nullable field names are italic.
A parent connector is optional when its foreign key is nullable. A unique foreign key allows at most one child.
client_id is an offline synchronization identifier, not a reference to another entity.
The original draw.io and v2 override files remain archived references; the downloadable Mermaid source describes v3.
